expected.subject: Robyn, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Robyn,

I'm with Legora, the legal AI platform for Real Estate used by partners at Goodwin and White & Case.

As Real Estate Partner and Practice Group Co-Chair, you're probably still spending too much time coordinating and guiding associates through developing contract forms, playbooks, and lease agreements project after project.

I'd love to share the use cases that other attorneys are using heavily for similar work in your practice area and hear your thoughts.

Would you be interested in seeing a brief demo?

William
Legora

notes: Based on proven US BDR template. Real estate-specific pain (contract forms, playbooks, lease agreements). Practice group co-chair = senior title.
